observations: Photo shows a PlayStation console with a DualShock controller in front.
Console appears to be the older/large “fat” PS4 style (thicker body).
No clear model/serial label visible; no ports/back shown.
No power-on screen, no game running, no controller pairing shown.
Some surface wear/scuffs visible on console and controller.

read_from: photo 0 (console shape and DualShock controller matching PS4 fat generation)

claims.claim: PS4 Fat Double Pad Good Condition
claims.evidence: Only one controller is clearly visible in photo 0; condition is not testable from photos.
Photo 0 shows only one DualShock controller.

risks.risk: Console may not power on / may have hardware faults (HDD/laser/PSU/overheating). Photos can’t confirm functionality.
risks.proof: Seller video: press power, boot to PS4 home screen, then open Settings → System Information.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case for used PS4).

risks.risk: Controller issue (drift, bad buttons, weak charging, not pairing). Photos can’t confirm controller health.
risks.proof: Video clip: controller connected, working in menus; show analog sticks responding (move in circles) and button presses.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming controller may be faulty/needs replacement.

risks.risk: “Double pad” may be false (only one controller included).
risks.proof: Photo showing both controllers side-by-side (front + back) and both serial/label areas if possible.

risks.risk: Storage capacity and whether HDD/SSD is included/healthy is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo/video: Settings → Storage (shows capacity) and/or System Information screen.

risks.risk: Account/activation status (primary PS4, possible lock/bans) can affect usability.
risks.proof: Video: Settings → Account Management → Activate as Your Primary PS4 (show status) and confirm ability to sign in/out.

proof_requests: Video: power on and boot to PS4 home screen (Settings → System Information visible).
Video: controller pairing and basic input test in menus (analog + buttons).
Clear photos of both controllers if claiming “double pad” (front and back).
Photo/video: Settings → Storage (capacity) and confirm HDD/SSD present.
Photo/video: Account Management → Activate as Your Primary PS4 status.
response.reason: The photos suggest a PS4 “fat” console, but functionality and the “double pad” claim can’t be verified (only one controller is visible). To price safely, we need proof of power-on and confirmation of included controllers.
